**ALGEBRAIC CONSTRUCTIONS IN THE CATEGORY OF VECTOR BUNDLES**

*CONSTANTIN M. ARCUS¸*

44 pp, 11 sections.

**Abstract.** In this paper we present the category of generalized Lie algebroids. Important results (a theorem of Maurer-Cartan type, theorems of Cartan type,...) emphasize the importance and the utility of the objects of this new category.
